woocommerce.add_order_note.description: Add a note to an order. If customer_note=True the note is emailed to the customer; otherwise it stays internal (visible in WP-Admin only).

input_schema.description:
Add a note to an order. If ``customer_note=True``, the note is
emailed to the customer; otherwise it's internal-only (visible to
operator/staff in WP-Admin).

customer_note.description: True = visible to customer (and emailed). False = internal note only.
customer_note.title: Customer Note

input_schema.title: AddOrderNoteInput

woocommerce.create_order.description: Create a new order. Each line item must reference a product_id, a variation_id (for variable products), or both — the variation_id wins when both are supplied. Status defaults to 'pending' so the operator can review; call update_order_status to move it forward once payment is confirmed.

AddressInput.title: AddressInput

LineItemInput.description:
Order line item on creation.

Either ``product_id`` (for simple products) or ``variation_id`` (for
a specific variation of a variable product) must be supplied. When
both are supplied, WooCommerce uses the variation; we accept the
pair so the LLM can be explicit, but ``variation_id`` wins.

subtotal.description: Optional manual line subtotal (string decimal). Leave unset to let WooCommerce compute from product price.
subtotal.title: Subtotal

LineItemInput.title: LineItemInput

input_schema.description:
Create a new order. ``status`` defaults to 'pending' so the
operator can review before the order ships; the agent flips it to
'processing' / 'on-hold' via update_order_status once payment is
confirmed externally.

customer_id.description: WooCommerce customer id. 0 or null = guest checkout.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

status.description: Default 'pending' so the operator can review.
status.title: Status

input_schema.title: CreateOrderInput

AddressOutput.description:
Billing / shipping address as Woo returns it.

All fields optional because real stores rarely fill them all in
(especially shipping when the order is digital).
AddressOutput.title: AddressOutput

LineItemOutput.description:
Order line item as surfaced by Woo on order read.

The LLM needs enough to reason about the order: product, variation
(for variable products), quantity, line totals, and the SKU. Tax
detail is summarised; refunds are not exposed at this layer (out of
scope for the agent's job; the operator panel has them).
LineItemOutput.title: LineItemOutput

OrderDetail.description: Full order for a single ``get_order`` call.
OrderDetail.title: OrderDetail

woocommerce.get_product.description: Fetch one product by id OR by sku. Returns the full product including attributes (with all available options) and the list of variation ids. Use woocommerce.list_product_variations to expand variations.

input_schema.description: Identify a product by id OR sku. Exactly one must be provided.
input_schema.title: GetProductInput

AttributeCompact.description:
Compact attribute representation for a product or variation.

For a *product* (variable type), ``options`` lists every available
value across all variations. For a *variation*, ``option`` holds
the single selected value and ``options`` is empty.
AttributeCompact.title: AttributeCompact

CategoryRef.description: Minimal category reference embedded in product responses.
CategoryRef.title: CategoryRef

ImageRef.description:
First image of a product / variation. Only the URL — alt text and
image IDs are skipped to keep the LLM context small.
ImageRef.title: ImageRef

ProductDetail.description: Full product for a single ``get_product`` call.

description.description: HTML stripped + truncated to 500 chars by the tool layer.
description.title: Description

short_description.description: HTML stripped + truncated to 500 chars by the tool layer.
short_description.title: Short Description

variations.description: Variation IDs. Empty for non-variable products. Call woocommerce.list_product_variations to expand.
variations.title: Variations

ProductDetail.title: ProductDetail

woocommerce.list_categories.description: List product categories. Useful to discover the slug to pass back into list_products' category filter.

woocommerce.list_customers.description: Search customers by email or display name. Returns a compact view; call woocommerce.get_customer for the full record including billing phone.

search.description: WooCommerce searches by email and display name.
search.title: Search

woocommerce.list_orders.description: List orders. Filter by status, customer id, creation date range and free-text search (customer name / order number). Returns a compact view per order; call woocommerce.get_order for full details including line items, billing/shipping address and totals.

after.description: ISO 8601 — list orders created after this datetime.
after.title: After

before.description: ISO 8601 — list orders created before this datetime.
before.title: Before

woocommerce.list_product_variations.description: List variations of a variable product (e.g. all (size, colour) combinations of a duvet cover). Returns each variation's id, sku, price, stock status, image and resolved attribute values. The agent needs the variation id (not the parent product id) when creating an order for a specific variation.

input_schema.description: Variations are scoped to one product — product_id is required.
input_schema.title: ListProductVariationsInput

AttributeCompact.description:
Compact attribute representation for a product or variation.

For a *product* (variable type), ``options`` lists every available
value across all variations. For a *variation*, ``option`` holds
the single selected value and ``options`` is empty.
AttributeCompact.title: AttributeCompact

ImageRef.description:
First image of a product / variation. Only the URL — alt text and
image IDs are skipped to keep the LLM context small.
ImageRef.title: ImageRef

ProductVariation.description: One variation of a variable product (e.g. 'funda, queen, azul').
ProductVariation.title: ProductVariation

woocommerce.list_products.description: List products in the connected WooCommerce store. Supports filtering by search term, category slug, product type (simple/variable), status, stock status and an attribute pair (e.g. attribute='pa_color' + attribute_term='azul' to list every product with the colour 'azul'). Paginated — inspect total_count and has_more to decide whether to request a follow-up page.

input_schema.description:
Filters mirror the WooCommerce ``GET /products`` endpoint, but
only the fields the agent actually uses. Adding more later is a
schema bump — keep the surface small for now.

attribute.description: Attribute slug, e.g. 'pa_color' or 'pa_size'. Must be combined with attribute_term.
attribute.title: Attribute

attribute_term.description: Attribute term slug, e.g. 'azul', 'queen'. Must be combined with attribute.
attribute_term.title: Attribute Term

input_schema.title: ListProductsInput

CategoryRef.description: Minimal category reference embedded in product responses.
CategoryRef.title: CategoryRef

ImageRef.description:
First image of a product / variation. Only the URL — alt text and
image IDs are skipped to keep the LLM context small.
ImageRef.title: ImageRef

ProductSummary.description:
Compact product, returned by list endpoints. Just enough to let
the LLM decide which product to ``get_product`` for detail.
ProductSummary.title: ProductSummary
